messages:
jess_support: fyi customer acme.ai hitting lots of 502/504s on hostedapi (eu1) after a traffic ramp at ~11:40UTC. They see streaming aborts and plain 502s. Customer says it started right after they doubled concurrency.

mike_sre: can you paste a sample trace id and a short curl we can use to repro? also region + model? :eyes:

jess_support: trace: trace-id=tr_9b3c4f2a, model=gptx-large, region=eu1. Quick repro curl they gave: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"stream test","stream":true}' \ 
  https://api.eu1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They attached logs showing a bunch of upstream GOAWAYs and some RST_STREAM.

deploy_bot: New config rollout (envoy-proxy-eu1) started 1767754300 by sam_prodops.

anya_eng: findings so far: envoy upstream connections show keepalive timeouts + HTTP/2 stream window exhaustion on midproxy. Patterns: many long-lived streams + infrequent small bursts => keepalive jitter -> upstream treats as idle -> GOAWAY then in-flight streams RST.

mike_sre: do we see auth service in the path causing stalls? jess, any auth latency spikes?

jess_support: auth latency looks fine in their traces (95p < 50ms). Errors correlate with long streaming sessions + concurrent embed requests.

anya_eng: quick mitigations to try: 1) lower envoy idle_timeout to keep connections hot, 2) bump h2 stream window or disable mutliplexing for the tenant, 3) enable prefix-KV caching for these workloads to reduce long stream count.

sam_prodops: rolling a hotfix to envoys in eu1: reduced h2 idle timeout from 120s -> 60s and increased max_concurrent_streams per upstream. will stage canary now.

mike_sre: while canary rolls, collect pcap and http2 debug logs for tr_9b3c4f2a and a couple of other sample traces. also check kernel tcp_keepalive settings on midproxy.

jess_support: customer confirmed transient improvement after 11:53UTC (post-canary) — their error rate dropped from ~42% -> ~4% for 15m, but they still see intermittent 502s under heavy concurrency.

anya_eng: next steps: instrument early-fallback for model swap on 502s, add a short-term rate cap per-tenant for streaming sessions, and schedule deeper load test with long-lived streams + small bursts.

sam_prodops: canary to full deploy at 1767754415. monitoring alerts cleared at 11:56UTC.

jess_support: customer ops will keep an eye. asked acme.ai to throttle concurrency to 75% while we run load tests. they agreed. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: follow-up items: - collect full envoy debug for 1767754300..1767754420 - load test plan (anya) - tenant ratecap plan (product) - add an integration test for h2 keepalive/jitter scenarios.

anya_eng: i’ll draft the load test and put steps here. quick note: repro with a mix of 50 long streaming sessions + 200 short embed calls hits the pattern locally. sharing script in thread shortly. :white_check_mark:

deploy_bot: Rollout to eu1 completed 1767754415 by sam_prodops.

jess_support: closing initial escalation for now — will reopen if customer sees >5% 502s again. thanks everyone. :heart:
